description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and macros related to handling Git pack files, including packfile management, indexing, and object retrieval.

classes.name: packed_git
classes.description: Represents a Git packfile with metadata, index data, and associated repository.

classes.name: packfile_list
classes.description: A linked list of packfile entries.

classes.name: packfile_list_entry
classes.description: An entry in the packfile list, containing a pointer to a pack and the next list element.

classes.name: packfile_store
classes.description: Manages a collection of packfiles for a Git repository, including loading, caching, and reordering.

classes.name: pack_window
classes.description: Represents a memory-mapped window of a packfile for object data access.

classes.name: pack_entry
classes.description: Represents an object within a packfile with its offset and associated pack.

methods.name: packfile_list_clear
methods.description: Clears all entries in a packfile list.

methods.name: packfile_list_remove
methods.description: Removes a specific pack from a packfile list.

methods.name: packfile_list_prepend
methods.description: Prepends a pack to a packfile list.

methods.name: packfile_list_append
methods.description: Appends a pack to a packfile list.

methods.name: packfile_list_find_oid
methods.description: Finds a pack containing a specific object ID.

methods.name: packfile_store_new
methods.description: Creates a new packfile store for a given object database.

methods.name: packfile_store_free
methods.description: Frees the packfile store and all associated resources.

methods.name: packfile_store_close
methods.description: Closes all packfiles in the store without freeing them.

methods.name: packfile_store_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the store by loading packfiles and indices.

methods.name: packfile_store_reprepare
methods.description: Reinitializes the store, reloading packfiles.

methods.name: packfile_store_add_pack
methods.description: Adds a pack to the store, taking ownership.

methods.name: packfile_store_read_object_stream
methods.description: Reads an object stream from the store.

methods.name: packfile_store_read_object_info
methods.description: Reads object info from the store.

methods.name: packfile_store_get_packs
methods.description: Returns all packs managed by the store.

methods.name: packfile_store_load_pack
methods.description: Loads a packfile into the store.

methods.name: packfile_store_freshen_object
methods.description: Refreshes an object in the store.

methods.name: odb_pack_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for a pack with a given checksum.

methods.name: pack_basename
methods.description: Returns the basename of a packfile.

methods.name: parse_pack_index
methods.description: Parses a pack index file into a packed_git structure.

methods.name: for_each_file_in_pack_subdir
methods.description: Iterates over files in a pack subdirectory.

methods.name: for_each_file_in_pack_dir
methods.description: Iterates over files in a pack directory.

methods.name: for_each_object_in_pack
methods.description: Iterates over objects in a pack.

methods.name: for_each_packed_object
methods.description: Iterates over all packed objects in a repository.

methods.name: report_garbage
methods.description: Reports invalid files in the pack directory.

methods.name: repo_approximate_object_count
methods.description: Returns a rough count of objects in the repository.

methods.name: pack_report
methods.description: Generates a report about the repository's packs.

methods.name: open_pack_index
methods.description: Memory-maps the pack index file.

methods.name: close_pack_index
methods.description: Unmaps the pack index file.

methods.name: close_pack_fd
methods.description: Closes the pack file descriptor.

methods.name: get_pack_fanout
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the pack's fanout table.

methods.name: use_pack
methods.description: Maps a pack's data into memory.

methods.name: close_pack_windows
methods.description: Closes all pack windows.

methods.name: close_pack
methods.description: Closes a pack.

methods.name: unuse_pack
methods.description: Unmaps a pack window.

methods.name: clear_delta_base_cache
methods.description: Clears the delta base cache.

methods.name: add_packed_git
methods.description: Adds a packed_git to the repository.

methods.name: unlink_pack_path
methods.description: Deletes pack files from disk.

methods.name: check_pack_index_ptr
methods.description: Checks bounds for a pointer into a pack index.

methods.name: bsearch_pack
methods.description: Binary searches for an object in a pack index.

methods.name: nth_packed_object_id
methods.description: Retrieves the object ID at a given position in a pack.

methods.name: nth_packed_object_offset
methods.description: Retrieves the offset of the nth object in a pack.

methods.name: find_pack_entry_one
methods.description: Finds the offset of an object in a pack.

methods.name: is_pack_valid
methods.description: Checks if a pack is valid.

methods.name: unpack_entry
methods.description: Unpacks an object entry from a pack.

methods.name: unpack_object_header_buffer
methods.description: Reads object header from a buffer.

methods.name: get_size_from_delta
methods.description: Calculates object size from delta.

methods.name: unpack_object_header
methods.description: Reads object header from a pack window.

methods.name: get_delta_base
methods.description: Retrieves delta base object.

methods.name: release_pack_memory
methods.description: Releases memory used by pack data.

methods.name: packed_object_info
methods.description: Retrieves info about a packed object.

methods.name: mark_bad_packed_object
methods.description: Marks a packed object as bad.

methods.name: has_packed_and_bad
methods.description: Checks for packed and bad objects.

methods.name: find_kept_pack_entry
methods.description: Finds a kept pack entry.

methods.name: has_object_pack
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in a pack.

methods.name: has_object_kept_pack
methods.description: Checks if an object exists in a kept pack.

methods.name: kept_pack_cache
methods.description: Returns cache of kept packs.

methods.name: is_promisor_object
methods.description: Checks if an object is in a promisor pack.

methods.name: load_idx
methods.description: Loads a pack index from memory for fuzz testing.

methods.name: parse_pack_header_option
methods.description: Parses pack header options.
